results.title: Top 10 nail trends of 2024 so far…
results.content: ## New trends data analysing Instagram and TikTok posts has revealed the top nail trends of 2024 (so far). The UK-based salon/spa booking app Fresha has analysed global TikTok and Instagram data on posts about nail trends and found that ultra-feminine nails have been a global favourite with social media users so far this year. As TikTok and Instagram are awash with amateur nail artists and experts showing off their creativity and individualism, the research analysed video and view counts for manicure trends on TikTok, along with the number of hashtags on Instagram and overall social media engagement to reveal the most popular ones. Between the start of the year and now, the ‘long nail’ trend has amassed 11,287,446 combined views and posts across TikTok and Instagram. Ultra-flattering almond-shaped nails have racked up 4,182,041 combined views and posts on Instagram and TikTok – making this a clear favourite in terms of nail shapes.
